Bethesda is reportedly getting ready to officially announce the full title of its Skyrim sequel: The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel . The leaked title, assuming it is legitimate, will not come as a surprise to the most attentive of fans, as the online community had already guessed Bethesda would use the TES 6: Sentinel moniker over the summer.
The theory emerged on August 11, when Xbox CEO Asha Sharma said she had checked in on TES 6 that morning and experienced a "live playthrough" at Bethesda. Apart from praising the game's "scale and grandeur," she referred to it as " The Elder Scrolls VI: ******** ." Assuming the number of asterisks accurately reflected the subtitle's length, fans quickly landed on "Sentinel," an eight-letter name belonging to one of Hammerfell's major cities on the Iliac Bay, a region long suspected to be the setting of TES 6 . The theory was further bolstered by the game's rumored "Guardian" codename, considering it is a near-synonym for sentinel.
TES 6: Sentinel Title Reveal Reportedly Coming Soon
That popular theory will soon end up proven correct, according to The Verge 's Tom Warren. The industry insider reports that Bethesda is preparing to formally announce the title of its long-awaited open-world RPG, with unnamed sources familiar with the studio's plans saying it will indeed be subtitled Sentinel . The reveal could reportedly arrive as early as November 2026, eight years and five months after TES 6 was first announced at the June 2026 edition of E3 . With November 11 marking Skyrim 's 15th anniversary, that date stands out as an obvious candidate for news about the long-awaited sequel.
It is unclear what form the purported title announcement will take. The most conservative scenario would see Bethesda reveal only the name, though some fans have long hoped the studio might pair it with a proper first look at the game after nearly a decade of waiting. The E3 2018 trailer hardly qualifies as one, as it was a CGI teaser produced while TES 6 was still in its concept phase , years before active development began in 2023.

A 'Sentinel' Subtitle Would Be the Final Confirmation of TES 6 Being Set in Hammerfell
Even if Bethesda reveals nothing beyond the subtitle, a Sentinel subtitle would effectively confirm Hammerfell as the primary setting of TES 6 . As the name of one of the largest Redguard cities, it would be difficult to interpret as anything other than a geographic pointer. Excursions into neighboring regions would remain possible, but Hammerfell would become all but certain and, barring evidence to the contrary, the likeliest sole Tamriel province featured in the game.
With TES 6 having been in active development for around three years as of late 2026, the game is still unlikely to arrive before 2028, based on typical modern AAA development cycles. Bethesda did spend an uncharacteristically long time in pre-production, which may have helped refine the story and scope. However, pre-production inherently does little to accelerate asset creation, long one of the biggest bottlenecks in game development.
